answer: Admission proof-of-work at the gate: each identity must burn a puzzle costing ~500 CPU-hours (~$12 at spot rates), verified on-chain before rewards unlock. A horizon of expected returns caps farm ROI, so scaling to 10k sybils costs ~$120k upfront with zero guarantee of payout. Any whisper of cheap identity creation dies because marginal cost stays flat while per-agent yield decays. No fable of free accounts survives. This works because linear attacker cost meets sublinear reward, forcing sybil farms into guaranteed negative returns.
